lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular distribution of high-luminance circular clusters is visible along the mid-lateral flank, organized into roughly four primary horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable in the mid-body section, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like arrangement of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper and mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregularities and small notches are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a significantly higher density and more randomized distribution of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the organized grid on the lateral flank.
